quality_mode_description.exclude_low: Mode A: quarters whose underlying metrics are not quality_flag=ok are removed from the test and listed in excluded_quarters with a reason (DR-04.8, FR-52).
quality_mode_description.label_low: Mode B: all quarters are kept; low-quality observations are listed in low_quality_quarters.

holm_family: One family per company x x-variable x y-variable across lags 0..max_lag; Holm-adjusted p-values and the family label are reported on every result.
warnings: BT4/BT5: every x and y series is ADF-tested; when either is non-stationary at level, both series are first-differenced before Spearman and the effective n is reported.
Holm correction is applied per company x x-variable x y-variable across lags 0..max_lag (m=5).
Quality mode A (exclude_low) is the default; quality_mode_comparison contains mode B results. When mode A leaves fewer than 8 pairs, the result is insufficient_data instead of a forced estimate.
n after YoY/lag/differencing is reported; n < 30 means reference only.
